description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Added Vulkan capability detection — device support is now verified automatically before launching 26.2+ versions, with a new "Detect Vulkan" entry in version settings for manual checks and per-item extension/feature dependency details; the vkshim driver layer automatically synthesizes missing Vulkan capabilities.
2. The version list gained deep deletion, which also cleans up libraries and assets referenced only by that version; deletion progress is now shown in real time.
3. The mod list gained sorting by name/filename/size/modification time with ascending/descending toggle, and the choice is remembered.
4. The number seek bar gained +/- buttons on both sides, supporting tap to step and long-press to repeat.
5. The account skin dialog's 3D preview now applies the 3D skin layer and body-leg separation switch states.
6. Optimized mod scanning: repeated full scans of the same version are avoided, and the manage page refreshes incrementally after a mod download; the "installed" badge on the mod download page now matches across Modrinth and CurseForge.
7. Fixed Forge/NeoForge/OptiFine installation freezing and being impossible to cancel; processor progress is now shown in real time and hangs are detected automatically.
8. Fixed save errors and user layout loss caused by a controller initialization race.
9. Fixed Quilt installation crashes, system-info initialization crashes on some devices, and incomplete error messages in SDL message boxes.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增 Vulkan 能力检测，启动 26.2+ 版本前自动校验设备支持情况，版本设置页新增"检测 Vulkan"入口可手动检测并查看逐项扩展/特性依赖；vkshim 驱动层自动合成缺失的 Vulkan 能力
2.版本列表新增深度删除，可一并清理仅被该版本引用的库与资源文件，删除过程实时显示进度
3.模组列表新增排序，支持按名称/文件名/大小/修改时间升降序排列，选择自动记忆
4.数值调节条左右新增加减按钮，支持点按步进与长按连发
5.账户皮肤对话框 3D 预览同步应用 3D 皮肤层与身体腿部分离开关状态
6.模组扫描性能优化，同一版本避免重复全量扫描，下载模组后管理页自动增量刷新；模组下载页"已安装"标记支持 Modrinth 与 CurseForge 跨源匹配
7.修复 Forge/NeoForge/OptiFine 安装卡死且无法取消的问题，安装过程实时显示处理器进度，挂起自动检测收敛
8.修复控制器初始化竞态导致的保存报错与用户布局丢失
9.修复 Quilt 安装崩溃、部分设备系统信息初始化崩溃、SDL 消息框错误信息显示不全等问题
